final_text: Fixed two bugs in `rtl/shift_reg.v`: `load` was incorrectly gated by `en` (now takes priority independently), and the right-shift was feeding in a constant `0` instead of `sin`. The design now matches the spec, and `TEST PASSED` — all tests pass.
